test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. It is assumed that the information given in the statements is true, even if it differs from generally known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements. Statements:

 
• All bears are ants.
 
• No bear is a horse.

Conclusions:

 
• (I) No ant is a horse.
 
• (II) No horse is a bear.
solution:
Given Statements:

All bears are ants.

No bear is a horse.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f780913222768c35b8da0353cd312389c880afa1017a4fc712d56b267c2681f.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I) No ant is a horse:**

Since only a part* of the Ants (the part that is Bears) is definitely separate from Horses, the remaining part of the Ants (Ants that are *not* Bears) might or might not be Horses.

Therefore, the conclusion "No ant is a horse" does not logically follow.

Conclusion (I) follows.

**(II) No horse is a bear:**

 

Since the statement "No bear is a horse" is true, its converse, "No horse is a bear," must also be true.

Therefore, the conclusion "No horse is a bear" **logically follows**.

So, **Only conclusion (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
